description: Roughly 30 rows of command-line-options.md's Table 1 - every logging.console/error/warn/info/debug/trace/stats.rotation.* and .collation_buffer_size sub-property - have a completely empty Description cell in the source markdown itself, verified against the raw file rather than an extraction gap. Only the log_level and log_keys rows in that family carry any description at all, leaving an operator with no in-page explanation of what most of the logging rotation settings do.
